result.brief: 提出 RePix-VFI：用一步视频扩散模型精化光流渲染草稿，并通过生成式回读将原始关键帧像素重新渲染后与生成外观融合，实现高效多帧视频插帧。
result.reason: Multi-frame VFI using one-step video diffusion prior plus flow-based re-rendering of observed keyframe pixels; directly serves video generation/interpolation with efficiency and appearance fidelity.
